name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション クルルロボMk-II
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Kururu Robo Mk-II

description.ja: 人気のロボシリーズから“クルルロボMk-II”発進！！
description.en: “Kuru Robo Mk-II” launches from the popular robot series! !

description.ja: クルルボール形態へ変形！
ロボに乗り込むクルル曹長も手足が可動。
description.en: Sergeant Major Krull who gets into the robot also has movable limbs.

description.ja: クルル曹長はロボのコクピットにもなるソーサーに乗せることが可能。
description.en: Sergeant Major Krull can be placed on a saucer that also serves as the robot's cockpit.
